messages:
Nora: Just received invoice AST-2026-410 from AstraCloud for $49,980 — PDF has no PO number and they billed our EU entity instead of Redwood US. attaching scan. Can AP pause? @Felix @Hana

ap-bot: invoice AST-2026-410 uploaded to AP queue. auto-pay: true

Felix: AP here I can stop auto-pay if you confirm HOLD. Need GL code, entity, and PO. Policy: >$50k needs PO/exec sign-off, but this is just under $50k; currency/entity mismatch still blocks payment.

Hana: This was for test runs on private cluster. Procurement shows a request but no formal PO — we used a contract commitment (contract AC-2025) with monthly billing. Vendor should invoice Redwood Inc (US), not Redwood EU.

Procurement: I see contract AC-2025 (approved) but it references Master SOW and billing entity is Redwood Inc. Vendor invoice to Redwood EU is an error. Also no PO was raised for this engagement.

Nora: I messaged billing@astracloud.com asking them to reissue to Redwood Inc and to include PO-AC-0001 if they can link to the SOW. Also asked for breakdown of charges (compute vs support).

Felix: Marking AP hold: HOLD_ENTITY_MISMATCH and created ticket AP-6612 to block payment cycle.

Hana: If vendor reissues for Redwood Inc we can process. If they insist EU entity, Legal needs to confirm tax implications and whether we should refuse payment.

Legal: Looping in Legal. If contract says Redwood Inc is bill-to, vendor must correct. If they argue different entity, we need signed amendment.

CFO: Quick note if vendor rebills to US entity and amount stays the same, approve immediate payment. If they demand EU billing and can't correct, escalate to execs. Keep me posted.

Nora: Vendor replied auto-receipt: "Received, will review and reissue within 48 hours."

Felix: Good. AP will hold until corrected invoice lands. Setting reminder 48h on AP-6612. Leaving :hourglass: reaction.

Nora: Pasting PDF header for triage:
```
Invoice: AST-2026-410
Date: 2026-05-11
Amount: $49,980.00
Bill-to: Redwood EU (incorrect)
PO: (none)
```

Procurement: I'll prepare a short note mapping the invoice lines to contract SOW so AP can match when they reissue.

Legal: If they reissue but still invoice EU, request a statement of why and a copy of their VAT registration.

CFO: Thanks team. Await vendor corrected invoice before releasing funds. :white_check_mark:
